svg.text: Vocabulary relationships in the research report
Each term links to report sections where it appears. Node and bar counts are separate: explicit (blue) and implicit (orange).

Method: explicit = literal term, acronym, or standard inflection; implicit = manually mapped paraphrase without the term. Counts cover report body, excluding references. Section links indicate at least one mention of either kind. Totals are per term, so overlapping terms can count the same text span more than once.
